name: CDHSW
summary: CDHS and its CDHSW extension used magnetized iron calorimetry for precision neutrino-nucleon measurements at CERN. A separate two-detector PS configuration searched for short-baseline disappearance.
detection_principle: Magnetized iron modules acted simultaneously as target, hadron calorimeter and muon spectrometer, with active planes reconstructing tracks and showers. The PS oscillation configuration compared spectra at two positions to test a baseline-dependent deficit.
